pcs.pc_description: obtain the instructions from service technician related to work to be carried out on the electric vehicle
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the electric vehicle

pcs.pc_description: determine work to be done and work requirements by obtaining required information from the job card and instructions received from supervisor

modules.module_title: Perform polishing and correction of paint defects

pcs.pc_description: perform polishing with appropriate abrasive compound and buffers on painted components of vehicle as per SOP/WI
identify minor paint imperfections such as scratches, swirl marks etc. and any remaining contamination on the vehicle parts/panels
ensure that detailer assistant covered the exterior parts/fittings adjacent to the painted panels with masking tape or paper to prevent their surface finish

use sandpaper with a specific set of grids to sand a particular area for removal of the defects
remove any contaminants, overspray, or residue left by using clay bar with the assistance of detailer assistant after the cleaning and polishing
apply paint sealer/wax on the vehicle parts to give final glossy shine on the painted panels/parts of vehicle by following SOP/WI
apply protective coating like ceramic / nano coating / Paint Protection Film (PPF) etc. on the vehicle to protect the paint of vehicle by following SOP/WI
inspect surface finish of vehicle parts/panels after vehicle detailing activities and report to supervisor in case of any discrepancy
ensure that all the cleaning and detailing activities are completed before releasing the vehicle
dispose off materials such as debris, old masking paper, empty cans/tube, etc. as per organization’s policies
return leftover consumable/parts, tools and equipment after completion of work
record the details of various treatment and washing activities done on the vehicle in job card as per organizational procedures

modules.module_title: Perform routine service, repair or maintenance of bicycle

pcs.pc_description: perform routine service/maintenance of various parts and aggregates including drive chain ring, steering system, brakes, suspension, pedals etc.
collect the correct spare parts and appropriate grade of lubricants, coolant, oils and grease for routine maintenance and service
inspect the components requiring adjustment or replacement due to continuous wear and tear such as bell, tires, reflectors, brake pads, chain ring, cassettes and freewheels etc.

adjust the saddle fore, aft and height as per the requirement
seek assistance from the specialist in case of structural repairs
check the performance of bicycle/aggregate post repair before releasing it to customer
dispose-off materials such as waste oil, scrap of failed parts/aggregates, as per environmental policies
perform scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools and equipment after completion of work

modules.module_title: Prepare for service and repair work

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand work to be carried out
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the electric bicycle
collect workshop tools/measuring devices/equipment required for the job and check their condition/calibration
prepare the electric bicycle according to nature of job to be performed: general, mechanical or electrical job on the electric bicycle
wear PPE according to nature of job to be performed
conduct visual inspection of the electric bicycle to identify defects and indirect faults in electrical/electronic aggregate due to other system/component
assess mechanical aggregates such as gear shifter, handle, axles, paddles brakes, wheels, etc. of the electric bicycle for any external impact/bend/incorrect fitment/wear & tear
report the malfunctions/repairs in the electric bicycle beyond own scope to the concerned person

modules.module_title: Perform routine service and minor repairs

pcs.pc_description: take precautions to avoid damage to the electric bicycle and its components while working on various aggregates
use appropriate tools, equipment, and consumables as per nature of job and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) recommended by the organization
test electrical/electronic components performance of electric bicycle wherever applicable as per OEM SOP
remove parts relevant to various mechanical aggregates and place them securely as specified by OEM
clean and condition dismantled mechanical and electrical components prior to assembly
perform minor repair/replacement/calibration of mechanical system/aggregate such as brake lever free play, drive chain, braking & steering systems adjustments, etc. as per SOP
apply appropriate grade of oil or other lubricant on the mechanical components of electric bicycle wherever applicable as per OEM guidelines
maintain the documentation related to inspection, servicing and minor repair of the electric bicycle

modules.module_title: Assist lead technician in diagnosis or troubleshooting the faults

pcs.pc_description: conduct test ride of the e-bike to assist the lead technician in assessing the service/repair requirement or calibration/adjustments, if any
follow lead technician instructions to choose and use the appropriate device/equipment to inspect/test electric bicycle/system/component performance to diagnose defects or faults in it
carry out inspection or test on electric bicycle mechanical and electrical systems according to lead technician instructions
interpret and compare results of diagnostic inspections/tests with vehicle specifications and regulatory requirements
maintain the documentation related to inspections and troubleshooting performed on the vehicle
report the results to lead technician and seek assistance if further tests or inspections are required to conclude the diagnosis or troubleshooting
check the performance of electric bicycle post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the electric bicycle for the next procedure
dispose of materials such as old batteries, scrap of failed parts/aggregates as per organization’s policies
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed to the person concerned
